messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT 3432 — fncall error rate spike on prod (p50 latency +70%, fncall errors 18%). Paging oncall.
oncall-bot: Links: https://redwood.prod/incidents/3432 | graph: https://metrics/redwood/fncall/errors
morgan: I'm on it. first pass: how widespread?
sam: top line — ~6% of requests hit fncalls, but they account for 42% of failed requests. A few large tenants (acct-182, acct-99) are spiking with repeated structured output failures.
morgan: thanks. can we do a quick mitigation: restrict structured output JSON size and disable agent/tool invocation for best-effort tier?
ben: we can push a config toggle to traffic-shaper to do two things: 1) cap structured output generation to 1k tokens, 2) drop fncall routing for non-paid tiers (fall back to text-only).
nina: that's potentially customer-impacting. CS wants list of affected customers before we flip. @cs-esc can you pull last 30m of errors by tenant?
cs-esc: pulling now. will post summary in ~2m.
infra-bot: FYI deploy queue shows 1 running, no conflicting deploys for traffic-shaper service.
(30s later) cs-esc: Top affected tenants: acct-182 (8% of failures), acct-99 (6%), trial accounts bulk (12%). Estimated % of active users affected: ~4.5%.
morgan: ok, propose a staged mitigation: 1) immediate global soft-rate-limit on fncall endpoints (10rps per tenant cap) 2) enable structured-output-size cap (1k) for all tenants 3) disable fncall for free tiers only (quick rollback path).
sam: I can push #1 and #2 via the runtime feature flags. Commands:```bash
# soft limit
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://control-plane/api/flags \n  -d '{"feature":"fncall_rate_cap","value":{"type":"global","limit_rps":10}}'\n# structured output cap
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://control-plane/api/flags \n  -d '{"feature":"structured_output_cap","value":{"max_tokens":1000}}'
```
ben: for #3 I need to update routing policies; doing a canary in us-east-1 first (route 2% of traffic through free-tier-disable). Command:```json
{"route":"fncall","policy":"disable_for_tier","tier":"free","percent":2}
```
morgan: start canary, monitor errors and latency for 5m, then ramp if stable. sam, ben — coordinate on the timing. I'll start notifying CS and SRE.
cs-esc: pinged CSMs for acct-182 and acct-99. Mentioned potential temporary degradation for free/trial users. They asked for ETA on fixes.
sam: initiating flag updates now. patch-id: ff-3432-structcap. rolling to control-plane in 30s.
ops-bot: Flag ff-3432-structcap set by sam at 1959998920.
ben: canary request submitted to routing-engine at 1959998928. percent=2, region=us-east-1.
infra-bot: monitoring hooks added: fncall_error_rate, structured_output_errors, overall_latency. Alerts rearmed for 2m windows.
morgan: checkpoints: 1) flags pushed, 2) canary running. wait 5m then decide ramp.
(4m later) cs-esc: CSMs report acct-99 seeing fewer cascading failures, acct-182 still noisy but reduced token blowups.
sam: canary looks good — fncall errors down 55% in us-east canary, p50 latency down 40%. Recommend ramp to 20% then 100% for free-tier disable if trends hold.
ben: ramping to 20% now. routing-engine response: accepted.
(30s later) ops-bot: routing-engine: ramp to 20% complete at 1959999062.
morgan: good. cs-esc can you follow-up with CS to update customers? Put a note in incident ticket that we're doing staged mitigations, expected full mitigation within 15-20m.
cs-esc: done. message sent to CSMs and logged.
nina: incoming handoff — my shift starts in 18m. I will take over if this remains ongoing. morgan, please add any follow-ups for next oncall.
morgan: noted — next oncall @nina, handoff checklist: 1) monitor fncall_error_rate and structured_output_errors dashboards 2) be ready to revert free-tier-disable (route rollback) 3) coordinate with CS for impacted tenants.
nina: copy that. put me on pager for this incident.
(10m later) sam: errors stable at reduced rate, no new hotspots, p50 latency improving. I will keep flags in place for 30m then plan for gradual revert if stable.
morgan: leaving now — @nina you'll be primary. if anything spikes >10% error rate increase, escalate to page SRE and run `scripts/rollback_free_tier_disable.sh`. :thumbsup:
nina: acknowledged. taking over.
oncall-bot: Incident 3432 acknowledged by nina at 1959999005.
(END OF THREAD)
